body.note:
All values used for pre-Si estimates and are subject to change.
1 Assumes thermally constrained system at steady state (i.e., turbo headroom exhausted) CPU PL1 or combined (CPU+GPU) Power Share PL1 (PSL1) Target @ Tsn limit.
2 Narrow VDC (NVDC) has system loss in AC Mode only. Ignore in Battery Mode OR if using alternative PD designs (i.e., Hybrid Power Boost (HPB) or WVDC).
3 a) Assumes 0.5C Charge Rate (example, max charge rates are tightly controlled typically starts ~30% and released/backed-off by ~50% Battery State of Charge). It's maybe possible to manage this to be negligible charging loss with platform management tools like DTT during sustained high concurrency levels.
4 Downstream VR Losses are based on improved VR efficiencies by +3% for NVDC versus alternate PD designs.
5 Refer to the Section 5.1 for each workload definitions external hardware configurations and application mix detail assumptions.
6 Assumes ASPM CPU PCIe settings for low power link states are properly enabled and only the workload of interest is running. If making measurements, one should confirm and be aware of background apps impact. Like running other telemetry monitoring/ logging tools such as PTAT, SoCWatch, etc. could add power (+200-300mW per tool).
